runs.label: REAL
runs.command: membrane-run --model models/qwen2.5-1.5b-instruct-fp16.gguf --prompt "The capital of France is" --ctx 256 --gen-tokens 8 --gpu-layers auto --kv native --kv-placement gpu --json --quiet
runs.purpose: Section 27.C's spirit, but genuinely unplanned and real (not test-only injected): on this shared, memory-constrained dev host, available GPU memory shrank between plan time and apply time. The primary candidate (28 GPU layers, GPU-resident KV) was correctly SKIPPED (SKIPPED_UPDATED_MEMORY, Section 11/22 -- not attempted, not a failure), and the fallback controller cleanly reloaded the model at the next legal already-ranked Phase-20 candidate (0 GPU layers, CPU-resident KV, still --kv native as explicitly requested -- Section 5/26: precision was never silently changed) and completed the run successfully. Reproduced twice with the same qualitative outcome (real free-byte figures below were captured from the second, final run).

runs.label: REAL
runs.command: membrane-run --model models/qwen2.5-1.5b-instruct-fp16.gguf --prompt "The capital of France is" --ctx 256 --gen-tokens 4 --auto --json --quiet
runs.purpose: Section 26 regression check: bare --auto (adaptive precision) on Qwen2.5 must still fail closed at the PLANNER stage (compat_check.c's architecture gate), before Phase 21 ever engages -- the fallback controller must never get a chance to 'helpfully' turn an incompatible request into native.
runs.note: resolve_gpu_config() returns false before model load; membrane_fallback_run() is never called for this request -- the empty planner_used/no fallback object is the correct, expected outcome, not a gap.
